sips.title: Documentation is the leverage point
sips.what_changes: Every accountability outcome — the agent's arrest, the judge's rebuke — began with someone recording. Protect the documenters.

sips.title: Care work at scale
sips.what_changes: 11,000 quilt squares and 1,600 comfort kits are the visible tip of care work that must not burn out.
